headline: Little rituals you won't know were the good part until they're gone
items: The towel hood after a bath, one ear poking out
Kissing each fist before the sleep sack zips, left and then right
The walk to the window to say goodnight to the same streetlight
Counting their toes aloud at every change, even at 3am
turn: None of these get a last day. They just quietly stop.
